witness_description: The one-vertex edgeless graph. It is triangle-free and planar, and its largest induced forest has size 1.
refutation_explanation: For n = 1, the claimed lower bound is 5/9 + 20/27 = 35/27. Every induced forest has size at most 1, and 1 < 35/27, so this graph has no induced forest meeting the claimed bound.
search_space: All labeled simple undirected graphs on the vertex set {0}: exactly 1 graph (the edgeless graph), together with all 2 vertex subsets used to compute its maximum induced-forest size.
